holdout_policy: Fresh v7 acceptance holdout created after MG1-v6 closed. None of these exact prompt strings may be imported from prior acceptance epochs. Freeze before any v7 live execution; no post-result edits, drops, reclassification, candidate tuning or threshold tuning.
